Row.SQL: WITH check_mutation_result AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1::text AS "title", $2::text AS "summary", $3::text AS "content", $4::uuid AS "uploader_id") AS data WHERE true), mutation_result AS (INSERT INTO "public"."kb_entries" ("title", "summary", "content", "uploader_id") SELECT check_mutation_result."title", check_mutation_result."summary", check_mutation_result."content", check_mutation_result."uploader_id" FROM check_mutation_result RETURNING *) SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_physical")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT "id"::text AS "id", "title"::text AS "title", "summary"::text AS "summary", "content"::text AS "content", "uploader_id"::text AS "uploader_id", "created_at"::text AS "created_at", "updated_at"::text AS "updated_at", "embeddings"::text AS "embeddings", "embeddings_outdated"::text AS "embeddings_outdated" FROM mutation_result) AS "_physical"

Batch.SQL: WITH check_mutation_result AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1::uuid AS "department_id", $2::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "kb_entry_id" UNION ALL SELECT $3::uuid AS "department_id", $4::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "kb_entry_id") AS data WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."kb_entries" g WHERE data."kb_entry_id" = g."id" AND g."uploader_id" = $5::uuid) AND data."department_id" = ANY($6::uuid[])), check_count AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_mutation_result) >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT 0 FROM (SELECT constellation_throw_error('check constraint of an insert/update permission has failed', 'ZZ901')) x) END AS status), mutation_result AS (INSERT INTO "public"."kb_entry_departments" ("department_id", "kb_entry_id") SELECT check_mutation_result."department_id", check_mutation_result."kb_entry_id" FROM check_mutation_result WHERE (SELECT status FROM check_count) = 1 RETURNING *) SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_physical")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT "id"::text AS "id", "kb_entry_id"::text AS "kb_entry_id", "department_id"::text AS "department_id" FROM mutation_result) AS "_physical"

Insert.FinalSQL: WITH mutation_result AS (SELECT (value ->> 'id')::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "id", (value ->> 'title')::text::pg_catalog.text AS "title", (value ->> 'summary')::text::pg_catalog.text AS "summary", (value ->> 'content')::text::pg_catalog.text AS "content", (value ->> 'uploader_id')::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "uploader_id", (value ->> 'created_at')::text::pg_catalog.timestamptz AS "created_at", (value ->> 'updated_at')::text::pg_catalog.timestamptz AS "updated_at", (value ->> 'embeddings')::text::pg_catalog.text AS "embeddings", (value ->> 'embeddings_outdated')::text::pg_catalog.bool AS "embeddings_outdated" FROM json_array_elements($1::json) AS "_rows"(value)) SELECT row_to_json((SELECT "_e" FROM (SELECT mutation_result."title" AS "title") AS "_e")) FROM mutation_result
